signature.name: Spirit bond
signature.description: Choose from 16 pets at the Aeven Eggkeeper or earn bound eggs from monsters. Five tiers share combat stats within each tier; stronger tiers improve damage and accuracy. One TP-funded living bond lasts until your death. Travel, logout and TP exhaustion keep it. Recover 0.4% max TP every 2 seconds; double sitting, half in PK. PK areas use stronger spirit casting instead of pets.
